```{r}
chicken_data <- merge(chicken_data_me, y = data_li)
chicken_data <- JoinLayers(chicken_data)
# Identify genes starting with "ENSGALGAL"
genes_to_remove <- grep("^ENSGALG", rownames(chicken_data), value = TRUE)

# Filter them out of the object
chicken_data <- subset(chicken_data, features = setdiff(rownames(chicken_data), genes_to_remove))

```

```{r}
options(future.globals.maxSize=10000*1024^2)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(SeuratDisk)

# Step 1. Split Seurat object by metadata feature
# Replace "collector" with your metadata column name
chicken_list <- SplitObject(chicken_data, split.by = "collector")

# Step 2. Normalize, find variable features, and run PCA for each dataset
chicken_list <- lapply(chicken_list, function(x) {
  x <- NormalizeData(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- ScaleData(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- RunPCA(x, assay = "RNA")
  return(x)
})

# Step 3. Select integration features
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = chicken_list, nfeatures = 500)

# Step 4. Find integration anchors using RPCA
# The reduction = "rpca" argument triggers RPCA-based integration
chicken_anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = chicken_list,
  anchor.features = features,
  reduction = "rpca"
)

# Step 5. Integrate the datasets
chicken_integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = chicken_anchors)
```


```{r}
# Step 6. Downstream analysis
DefaultAssay(chicken_integrated) <- "integrated"
chicken_integrated <- ScaleData(chicken_integrated)
chicken_integrated <- RunPCA(chicken_integrated)
chicken_integrated <- FindNeighbors(chicken_integrated)
```


```{r}
chicken_integrated <- RunUMAP(chicken_integrated, dims = 1:30)

# Step 7. (Optional) Clustering
chicken_integrated <- FindNeighbors(chicken_integrated, dims = 1:30)
chicken_integrated <- FindClusters(chicken_integrated, resolution = 0.5)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(SeuratDisk)

# Step 1. Split Seurat object by metadata feature
# Replace "collector" with your metadata column name
chicken_list <- SplitObject(chicken_integrated_actual, split.by = "collector")

# Step 2. Normalize, find variable features, and run PCA for each dataset
chicken_list <- lapply(chicken_list, function(x) {
  x <- NormalizeData(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- ScaleData(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- RunPCA(x, assay = "RNA")
  return(x)
})

# Step 3. Select integration features
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = chicken_list, nfeatures = 500)

# Step 4. Find integration anchors using RPCA
# The reduction = "rpca" argument triggers RPCA-based integration
chicken_anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = chicken_list,
  anchor.features = features,
  reduction = "rpca"
)

# Step 5. Integrate the datasets
chicken_integrated_actual <- IntegrateData(anchorset = chicken_anchors)
```


```{r}
# Step 6. Downstream analysis
DefaultAssay(chicken_integrated_actual) <- "integrated"
chicken_integrated_actual <- ScaleData(chicken_integrated_actual)
chicken_integrated_actual <- RunPCA(chicken_integrated_actual)
chicken_integrated_actual <- RunUMAP(chicken_integrated_actual, dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE)

# Step 7. (Optional) Clustering
chicken_integrated_actual <- FindNeighbors(chicken_integrated_actual, dims = 1:20)
```

```{r}
# Find markers for each ident/cluster
markers <- FindAllMarkers(
  chicken_integrated_actual,
  only.pos = TRUE,
  min.pct = 0.25,
  logfc.threshold = 0.25
)

# Select top DE genes per cluster
library(dplyr)

top_genes <- markers %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_max(order_by = avg_log2FC, n = 5) %>%
  ungroup()

genes_use <- unique(top_genes$gene)
```


```{r}

p <- DotPlot(
  chicken_integrated_actual,
  features = genes_use,
  assay = "RNA",
  cols = c('yellow', 'purple'),
  dot.min = 0,
  col.min = -1,
  col.max = 2
) + 
  scale_fill_gradient2(
    low = "yellow",
    mid = "yellow",
    high = "purple",
    midpoint = 0
  ) +
  RotatedAxis() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 90,   # vertical text
      hjust = 1,
      vjust = 0.5,
      family = "Arial"
    ),
    axis.text.y = element_text(family = "Arial"),
    text = element_text(family = "Arial")
  )

ggsave(
```

```{r}
# 1. Subset query cells (by metadata column)
query <- subset(
  chicken_integrated_actual,
  subset = collector == "me_2"
)

# Drop problematic slots from RNA assay
# Inspect layers
Layers(query[["RNA"]])

query <- DietSeurat(
  query,
  assays = "integrated",
  layers = c("counts", "data")
)



# 3. Find transfer anchors
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = chicken_integrated_actual,
  query = query,
  dims = 1:30,
  reference.reduction = "pca"
)

# 4. Transfer labels
predictions <- TransferData(
  anchorset = anchors,
  refdata = chicken_integrated_actual$cellType,
  dims = 1:30
)

# 5. Add predictions to QUERY object (IMPORTANT)
query <- AddMetaData(
  object = query,
  metadata = predictions
)

```

```{r}
chicken_integrated_actual <- RunUMAP(chicken_integrated_actual, dims = 1:20, return.model = TRUE)

# 1. Subset query cells (by metadata column)
query <- subset(
  chicken_integrated_actual,
  subset = collector == "me_2"
)
# 3. Find transfer anchors
anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = chicken_integrated_actual,
  query = query,
  dims = 1:20,
  reference.reduction = "pca"
)

query <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = anchors,
  query = query,
  reference = chicken_integrated_actual,
  refdata = list(cellType = "cellType"),
  reference.reduction = "pca",
  reduction.model = "umap"
)
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)

#chicken_integrated_intlat <- subset(chicken_integrated_intlat, med_2p_branch %in% c("IntP", "IntA/Lat"))
#chicken_integrated_intlat <- subset(chicken_integrated_intlat, TimePoint == "E14.5")
# --------------------------------------------------
# Define gene modules
# --------------------------------------------------
ra_positive <- c(
  #"Rarb",
  #"Crabp2",
  "NR2F2",
  "NR2F1",
  "MEIS2",
  "MEIS1",
  "CRABP1"
)

fgf8_positive <- c(
  "CNPY1",
  "EN1",
  "EN2"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Set object and grouping variable
# --------------------------------------------------
obj <- chicken_integrated_intlat

#group_var <- "med_2p_branch"#"high_fate_label"   # change to your metadata column
assay_name <- "RNA"

#DefaultAssay(obj) <- assay_name

# --------------------------------------------------
# Keep only genes present in the object
# --------------------------------------------------
filter_present_genes <- function(genes, object, assay = DefaultAssay(object)) {
  present <- genes[genes %in% rownames(object[[assay]])]
  missing <- setdiff(genes, present)

  if (length(missing) > 0) {
    message(
      "Missing genes: ",
      paste(missing, collapse = ", ")
    )
  }

  return(present)
}

ra_positive_present <- filter_present_genes(
  ra_positive,
  obj,
  assay_name
)

fgf8_positive_present <- filter_present_genes(
  fgf8_positive,
  obj,
  assay_name
)

#combined_alltp_sub$med_2p_branch <- factor(
#  combined_alltp_sub$med_2p_branch,
#  levels = c("IntP", "IntA/Lat"))

# Check how many genes remain in each module
module_gene_counts <- c(
  RA_positive = length(ra_positive_present),
  FGF8_positive = length(fgf8_positive_present)
  
)

print(module_gene_counts)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Calculate module scores
# --------------------------------------------------
set.seed(123)

obj <- AddModuleScore(
  object = obj,
  features = list(ra_positive_present),
  cols = c("#228B22", "#ff9913"),#,
  assay = assay_name,
  name = "RA_positive_score",
  seed = 123,
  ctrl = 20,
  replace = TRUE
)

obj <- AddModuleScore(
  object = obj,
  features = list(fgf8_positive_present),
  cols = c("#228B22", "#ff9913"),#,
  ctrl = 20,
  assay = assay_name,
  name = "FGF8_positive_score",
  seed = 123,
  replace = TRUE
)



# AddModuleScore appends "1" to each supplied name
score_columns <- c(
  "RA_positive_score1",
  "FGF8_positive_score1"
)

# --------------------------------------------------
# Make separate violin plots
# --------------------------------------------------
p_ra_positive <- VlnPlot(
  obj,
  features = "RA_positive_score1",
  #group.by = group_var,
  cols = c("#228B22", "#ff9913"),
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  labs(
    title = "RA-positive program",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Module score"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )

p_fgf8_positive <- VlnPlot(
  obj,
  features = "FGF8_positive_score1",
  #group.by = group_var,
  cols = c("#228B22", "#ff9913"),
  pt.size = 0.5
) +
  labs(
    title = "FGF8-positive program",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Module score"
  ) +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(
      angle = 45,
      hjust = 1
    ),
    legend.position = "none"
  )



# --------------------------------------------------
# Combine plots
# --------------------------------------------------
p_combined <- (
  p_ra_positive |
  p_fgf8_positive
)


p_combined

# --------------------------------------------------
# Save
# --------------------------------------------------
ggsave(
  filename = "C:/Users/kebsc/OneDrive - Johns Hopkins/Manuscripts/figs/RA_FGF8_module_score_chicken_violins.svg",
  plot = p_combined,
  width = 11,
  height = 8
)
```

```{r}
# 3. Fetch EN1 and EN2 expression

  combined_alltp_e13,
  vars = c("En1"),
  slot = "data"
)

# 4. Define groups:
# EN1/EN2 positive = either gene expressed
# double negative = neither expressed
combined_alltp_e13$MEIS2_group <- ifelse(
  expr$En1 > 2,
  "EN_pos",
  "EN_neg"
)

# Optional: set order
combined_alltp_e13$MEIS2_group <- factor(
  combined_alltp_e13$MEIS2_group,
  levels = c("EN_pos", "EN_neg")
)

# 5. Violin plot
VlnPlot(
  combined_alltp_e13,
  features = c("Crabp1","Meis2"),
  group.by = "med_2p_branch",

)

combined_alltp_e13$med_2p_branch <- factor(
  combined_alltp_e13$med_2p_branch,

)
```

```{r}
load("C:/Users/kebsc/Downloads/GSE160471_RAW/GSM4873767_chicken_data.RData/GSM4873767_chicken_data.RData")
rm(inh)
ex <- UpdateSeuratObject(ex)

############################################
## 0. Packages
############################################
library(Seurat)
library(MetaNeighbor)
library(homologene)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(Matrix)

############################################
## 1. Extract expression matrices (Seurat v5)
############################################
# Use normalized RNA data (NOT scaled)
############################################
chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub <- subset(
  chicken_integrated_dcn_granule, 
  !(cell_type %in% c("Midbrain-fated Cells", "Granule Cells+UBCs", 'int prog'))
)

chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub <- subset(
  chicken_integrated_dcn_granule, 
  !(cell_type %in% c("Midbrain-fated Cells", "Granule Cells+UBCs", 'int prog'))
)

chicken_expr <- chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub@assays$integrated$data

 #GetAssayData(
#  ex,
#  layer = "data"
#)

############################################
## 2. Cluster identities
############################################
chicken_clusters <- chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub$cell_type
# Option 1: rename levels in place

#ex = subset(ex, !(merged.res.3.m.renamed %in% c("Med.A1", "Med.B1")))

ex$cluster_simple <- sub("\\..*$", "", ex$merged.res.3.m.renamed)
ex$med_label_clean <- gsub("[0-9]+$", "", ex$merged.res.3.m.renamed)
exceptions <- c("IntP.A", "IntP.B")
# Original cluster labels
# Original labels
labels <- ex$med_label_clean

# Keep exceptions, otherwise extract only a or b at the end
ex$med_label_grouped <- ifelse(
  labels %in% exceptions,
  labels,                            # leave exceptions unchanged
  sub(".*\\.(A|B).*", "\\1", labels) # keep only a or b at the end
)

#ex = subset(ex, cluster_simple != "IntP")
# Start from med_label_grouped
cl <- as.character(ex$cluster_simple)

# Create new grouping
ex$final_group <- cl

# Collapse IntP into one group
ex$final_group[cl %in% c("IntP.A", "IntP.B")] <- "IntP"

# Rename A/B to medA/medB
ex$final_group[cl == "A"] <- "MedA"
ex$final_group[cl == "B"] <- "MedB"

# Optional: make factor
ex$final_group <- factor(ex$final_group)

ex_clusters   <- ex$cluster_simple#cluster_simple_intp #Idents(mouse_data)

ex_expr <- ex@assays$RNA$data


############################################
## 5. Align genes across species
############################################
shared_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(ex_expr),
  rownames(chicken_expr)
)

ex_expr   <- ex_expr[shared_genes, ]
# 1. Extract expression matrix for shared genes
chicken_expr <- chicken_expr[shared_genes, ]

# 2. Extract cluster labels


############################################
## 6. Combine expression matrices
############################################
expr_all <- cbind(ex_expr, chicken_expr)

############################################
## 7. MetaNeighbor metadata
############################################
cell_metadata <- data.frame(
  cell_id = colnames(expr_all),
  species = c(
    rep("adult", ncol(ex_expr)),
    rep("chicken", ncol(chicken_expr))
  ),
  cluster = c(
    as.character(ex_clusters),
    as.character(chicken_clusters)
  )
)


rownames(cell_metadata) <- cell_metadata$cell_id

############################################
## 8. Gene set (recommended: mouse HVGs)
############################################
#geneset <- intersect(
#  FindAllMarkers(ex, group.by = "merged.res.3.m.renamed")$gene,
#  rownames(expr_all)
#  )
#geneset <- intersect(
#  rownames(expr_all),
#  rownames(expr_all)
#)
#genes1 <- FindAllMarkers(RL, group.by = "final.clusters2")$gene
#genes2 <- FindAllMarkers(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub, group.by = "cell_type_general")$gene

#genes1 <- toupper(genes1)


geneset <- intersect(
  rownames(expr_all),
  rownames(expr_all)
)

geneset_idx <- which(rownames(expr_all) %in% geneset)

############################################
## 9. Wrap expression in SummarizedExperiment
############################################
# This avoids the MetaNeighbor dgCMatrix assay() bug
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(expr = expr_all)
)

############################################
## 10. Run MetaNeighbor (THIS WORKS)
############################################
############################################
## 8. Gene set FIX: use all shared genes
############################################
geneset_idx <- seq_len(nrow(expr_all))

mn <- MetaNeighborUS(
  var_genes = geneset,
  dat = se,
  study_id = cell_metadata$species,
  cell_type = cell_metadata$cluster,
  fast_version = TRUE
)

############################################
## 11. Mouse ↔ Chicken AUROC matrix
############################################
# Full AUROC matrix
auroc <- mn

# Identify mouse and chicken rows/cols by name
ex_rows    <- grep("^adult\\|", rownames(auroc), value = TRUE)
chicken_cols  <- grep("^chicken\\|", colnames(auroc), value = TRUE)

ex_vs_chicken <- auroc[ex_rows, chicken_cols]






############################################
## 12. Plot
############################################
library(pheatmap)

pheatmap(
  ex_vs_chicken,
  color = colorRampPalette(c("white", "red"))(100),
  breaks = seq(0.5, 1, length.out = 101),
  dendrogram = FALSE,
  display_numbers = TRUE,         # Show numbers on each cell
  number_format = "%.2f",         # 2 decimal places
  main = "MetaNeighbor AUROC: Adult vs Chick (by chance = 0.5)"
)
```

```{r}
############################################
## Choose gene set for MetaNeighbor
############################################
gene_set_method <- "shared"   # "markers", "variable", or "shared"

############################################
## Cluster identities
############################################
ex <- subset(ex, !(cluster_simple %in% c("Med", "IntX", "MedL")))
RL <- subset(RL, !(subareas %in% c("Med", "MedDL", "MedL")))

chicken_clusters <- ex$cluster_simple
mouse_clusters <- RL$subareas

DefaultAssay(RL) <- "RNA"
DefaultAssay(ex) <- "RNA"

############################################
## Calculate variable genes (if selected)
############################################
if (gene_set_method == "variable") {

  RL <- FindVariableFeatures(
    RL,
    assay = "RNA",
    nfeatures = 500)

  ex <- FindVariableFeatures(
    ex,
    assay = "RNA",
    nfeatures = 500)

}

############################################
## Extract expression
############################################
mouse_expr <- GetAssayData(
  RL,
  layer = "data",
  assay = "RNA"
)

chicken_expr <- GetAssayData(
  ex,
  layer = "data",
  assay = "RNA"
)

############################################
## Chicken → Mouse orthologs
############################################
orthologs <- homologene(
  genes = rownames(chicken_expr),
  inTax = 9031,
  outTax = 10090
)

orthologs <- orthologs[, c("9031", "10090")]
colnames(orthologs) <- c("chicken_gene", "mouse_gene")

# strict 1-to-1 orthologs
orthologs <- orthologs[
  !duplicated(orthologs$chicken_gene) &
  !duplicated(orthologs$mouse_gene),
]

############################################
## Map chicken genes to mouse genes
############################################
common_chicken <- intersect(
  rownames(chicken_expr),
  orthologs$chicken_gene
)

gene_map <- orthologs[
  match(common_chicken, orthologs$chicken_gene),
]

chicken_mapped <- chicken_expr[common_chicken, ]
rownames(chicken_mapped) <- gene_map$mouse_gene


############################################
## Align genes
############################################
shared_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(mouse_expr),
  rownames(chicken_mapped)
)

mouse_expr <- mouse_expr[shared_genes, ]
chicken_expr <- chicken_mapped[shared_genes, ]


############################################
## Select gene set
############################################

if (gene_set_method == "variable") {

  mouse_hvg <- VariableFeatures(RL)

  chicken_hvg <- unique(
    orthologs$mouse_gene[
      match(
        VariableFeatures(ex),
        orthologs$chicken_gene
      )
    ]
  )

  chicken_hvg <- chicken_hvg[!is.na(chicken_hvg)]

  geneset <- Reduce(intersect, list(
    mouse_hvg,
    chicken_hvg,
    rownames(mouse_expr),
    rownames(chicken_expr)
  ))


} else if (gene_set_method == "shared") {

  geneset <- shared_genes


} else if (gene_set_method == "markers") {

  mouse_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
    RL,
    assay = "RNA",
    group.by = "subareas",
    only.pos = TRUE,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25,
    min.pct = 0.1
  )

  chicken_markers <- FindAllMarkers(
    ex,
    assay = "RNA",
    group.by = "cluster_simple",
    only.pos = TRUE,
    logfc.threshold = 0.25,
    min.pct = 0.1
  )

  library(dplyr)

  mouse_markers <- mouse_markers %>%
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 100)

  chicken_markers <- chicken_markers %>% 
    group_by(cluster) %>%
    slice_max(avg_log2FC, n = 100)

  mouse_marker_genes <- unique(mouse_markers$gene)

  chicken_marker_genes <- unique(
    orthologs$mouse_gene[
      match(
        chicken_markers$gene,
        orthologs$chicken_gene
      )
    ]
  )

  geneset <- Reduce(intersect, list(
    mouse_marker_genes,
    chicken_marker_genes,
    rownames(mouse_expr),
    rownames(chicken_expr)
  ))

}


cat(
  "Using",
  length(geneset),
  "genes (",
  gene_set_method,
  ")\n"
)


############################################
## Combine matrices
############################################
expr_all <- cbind(
  mouse_expr,
  chicken_expr
)

cell_metadata <- data.frame(
  cell_id = colnames(expr_all),
  species = c(
    rep("mouse", ncol(mouse_expr)),
    rep("chicken", ncol(chicken_expr))
  ),
  cluster = c(
    as.character(mouse_clusters),
    as.character(chicken_clusters)
  ),
  row.names = colnames(expr_all)
)


############################################
## MetaNeighbor
############################################
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(expr = expr_all)
)


mn <- MetaNeighborUS(
  var_genes = geneset,
  dat = se,
  study_id = cell_metadata$species,
  cell_type = cell_metadata$cluster,
  fast_version = TRUE
)

############################################
## 11. Mouse ↔ Chicken AUROC matrix
############################################

auroc <- mn

mouse_rows   <- grep("^mouse\\|", rownames(auroc), value = TRUE)
chicken_cols <- grep("^chicken\\|", colnames(auroc), value = TRUE)

mouse_vs_chicken <- auroc[mouse_rows, chicken_cols]

# Remove species prefixes
rownames(mouse_vs_chicken) <- sub("^mouse\\|", "", rownames(mouse_vs_chicken))
colnames(mouse_vs_chicken) <- sub("^chicken\\|", "", colnames(mouse_vs_chicken))

# Desired order
mouse_order <- c("IntP", "IntA", "Lat", "Med", "MedDL", "MedL")
chicken_order <- c("Lat_0", "Lat_1", "Lat_2", "IntX", "Med", "MedL")

# Keep only clusters present and reorder
mouse_order <- intersect(mouse_order, rownames(mouse_vs_chicken))
chicken_order <- intersect(chicken_order, colnames(mouse_vs_chicken))

mouse_vs_chicken <- mouse_vs_chicken[mouse_order, chicken_order]

############################################
## 12. Plot
############################################
```

```{r}

chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub = subset(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule, cell_type_ref_chicken %in% c("Midbrain-fated Cells",
  "IntP", 
  "Early Medial", "Late Medial", 
  "Granule Cells+UBCs"))

chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub.emb <- Embeddings(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub, "pca")[, 1:30]  # use first 10 PCs

# Get centroids of each endpoint cell type in PC space
A.idx <- which(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub$cell_type_ref_chicken == "Midbrain-fated Cells")
B.idx <- which(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub$cell_type_ref_chicken == "Granule Cells+UBCs")

A.centroid <- colMeans(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub.emb[A.idx, , drop = FALSE])
B.centroid <- colMeans(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub.emb[B.idx, , drop = FALSE])

# Direction vector from A to B in PC space
axis_vec <- B.centroid - A.centroid

# Normalize to unit length
axis_vec <- axis_vec / sqrt(sum(axis_vec^2))

# For each cell, subtract A and take dot product with axis_vec
# This gives a scalar coordinate along the A→B axis
proj_vals <- as.numeric((t(t(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub.emb) - A.centroid) %*% axis_vec))

# Optionally rescale 0–1 based on A and B positions
A_coord <- sum((A.centroid - A.centroid) * axis_vec)       # should be 0
B_coord <- sum((B.centroid - A.centroid) * axis_vec)
proj_vals_scaled <- (proj_vals - A_coord) / (B_coord - A_coord)

# Store in meta.data
chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub$axis_AB <- proj_vals_scaled
```


```{r}
df <- data.frame(
  axis_AB  = chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub$axis_AB,
  celltype = chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub$cell_type_ref_chicken
)

# Evolutionary timeline (0=ancient → 6=newest) - SAME AS BEFORE
df$evo_age <- case_when(
  df$celltype %in% c("Midbrain-fated Cells", "Granule Cells+UBCs") ~ 0,    
  df$celltype == "Early Medial" ~ 3,                                               
  df$celltype == "Late Medial" ~ 2,                                                 
  df$celltype == "IntP" ~ 5,                                                
  #df$celltype == "inta/lat" ~ 6,                                            
  #df$celltype == "int prog" ~ 4,                                        
  TRUE ~ 0
)


# Choose your specific order (example – edit as you like)
my_order <- c(
  "Midbrain-fated Cells",
  "IntP", 
  "Early Medial", "Late Medial", 
  "Granule Cells+UBCs"
)

# Apply ordering (and drop unused levels)
df$celltype <- factor(df$celltype, levels = my_order)
df$celltype <- droplevels(df$celltype)

# Recompute means with ordered factor
mean_lines <- aggregate(axis_AB ~ celltype, df, mean)

mean_lines <- aggregate(axis_AB ~ celltype, df, mean)
mean_lines$evo_age <- df$evo_age[match(mean_lines$celltype, df$celltype)]

library(ggplot2)
library(ggridges)

ggplot(df, aes(x = axis_AB, y = celltype, fill = evo_age)) +
  geom_density_ridges(scale = 2, alpha = 0.7, rel_min_height = 0.01) +
  geom_segment(
    data = mean_lines,
    aes(x = axis_AB, xend = axis_AB, y = 0, yend = Inf, color = evo_age),  # Now evo_age exists!
    linetype = "dashed",
    linewidth = 1,
    alpha = 0.6,
    inherit.aes = FALSE
  ) +
  scale_fill_gradientn(
    colors = c("black", "grey", "lightpink", "salmon", "red", "red3", "darkred"),

  scale_color_gradientn(

    name = "Evo Age"
  ) +
  xlim(-1, 1.5) +
  labs(x = "Projection onto A–B PC axis", y = "Cell type") +
  theme_classic() +
  theme(legend.position = "none")
```

```{r}
# Get PCA loadings matrix (genes x PCs)
pca_loadings <- Loadings(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub[["pca"]])

# Keep only the PCs you used for axis_vec (PCs 1:50)
pcs_used <- paste0("PC_", 1:30)
pcs_keep <- intersect(pcs_used, colnames(pca_loadings))
pca_loadings_subset <- pca_loadings[, pcs_keep]

# Project each gene's loadings onto your axis_vec
# This gives the "loading" of each gene specifically on the A→B axis
gene_axis_loadings <- as.numeric(pca_loadings_subset %*% axis_vec)

# Create ranked table
gene_axis_df <- data.frame(
  gene = rownames(pca_loadings_subset),
  axis_loading = gene_axis_loadings
)

# Rank by absolute loading (most influential on A→B axis)
gene_axis_df <- gene_axis_df[order(abs(gene_axis_df$axis_loading), decreasing = TRUE), ]

# Top 20 positive and negative
top_genes <- head(gene_axis_df, 30)$gene # highest positive contributors to A→B direction
head(gene_axis_df, 30)
tail(head(gene_axis_df, 40), 20)  # highest negative contributors
```

```{r}
library(dplyr)

# 1. Order cell types by mean axis_AB (A→B gradient)
celltype_means <- aggregate(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub$axis_AB, by = list(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub$cell_type_ref_chicken), mean)
celltype_order <- celltype_means$Group.1[order(celltype_means$x)]

# 2. Get ALL cells ordered by axis_AB within each cell type (FIXED SYNTAX)
cells_ordered <- chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub@meta.data %>%
  arrange(cell_type_ref_chicken, axis_AB) %>%
  rownames()

# 3. Subset object with cells in gradient order
chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub <- chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub[, cells_ordered]

# 4. Filter genes: expressed in ≥25% of cells AND mean > 0.1
top_50 <- head(gene_axis_df, 30)
expr_data <- chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_plot_sub[top_50$gene, ]
#pct_expr <- rowSums(expr_data > 0) / ncol(expr_data)

top_filtered <- top_50[pct_expr[top_50$gene] >= 0.25 & mean_expr[top_50$gene] > 0.1, ]

# 5. Split into pos/neg and order
top_pos <- top_filtered$gene[top_filtered$axis_loading > 0]
top_neg <- top_filtered$gene[top_filtered$axis_loading < 0]
spectrum_genes <- c(top_pos, rev(top_neg))
```

```{r}
############################################
## 0. Packages
############################################
library(Seurat)
library(MetaNeighbor)
library(homologene)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(Matrix)

############################################
## 1. Extract expression matrices (Seurat v5)
############################################
# Use normalized RNA data (NOT scaled)
############################################
chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub <- subset(
  chicken_integrated_dcn_granule, 
  !(cell_type %in% c("Midbrain-fated Cells", "Granule Cells+UBCs"))
)

chicken_expr <- GetAssayData(
  chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub,
  slot = "data"
)

############################################
## 2. Cluster identities
############################################
chicken_clusters <- chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub$cell_type

mouse_data_sub <- subset(
  combined_alltp,
  subset = !(med_2p_branch %in% c("RL", "Med", "Int/Lat Prog", "IntA", "Lat"))
)

mouse_data_sub <- subset(
  mouse_data_sub,
  TimePoint %in%  c("E13.5")
)

mouse_clusters   <- mouse_data_sub$med_2p_branch#Idents(mouse_data)

mouse_expr <- GetAssayData(
  mouse_data_sub,
  layer = "data",
  assay = "RNA"
)
DefaultAssay(mouse_data_sub) <- "SCT"
#mouse_data_sub <- PrepSCTFindMarkers(mouse_data_sub)

genes <- FindAllMarkers(
  mouse_data_sub,
  assay   = "SCT",
  group.by = "med_2p_branch"
)

############################################
## 3. Chicken → Mouse orthologs (NO BioMart)
############################################
# Taxonomy IDs:
# Chicken = 9031
# Mouse   = 10090
orthologs <- homologene(
  genes  = rownames(chicken_expr),
  inTax  = 9031,
  outTax = 10090
)

orthologs <- orthologs[, c("9031", "10090")]
colnames(orthologs) <- c("chicken_gene", "mouse_gene")

# Keep strict 1-to-1 orthologs
orthologs <- orthologs[
  !duplicated(orthologs$chicken_gene) &
  !duplicated(orthologs$mouse_gene),
]

############################################
## 4. Map chicken expression → mouse genes
############################################
common_chicken <- intersect(
  rownames(chicken_expr),
  orthologs$chicken_gene
)

gene_map <- orthologs[
  match(common_chicken, orthologs$chicken_gene),
]

chicken_mapped <- chicken_expr[common_chicken, ]
rownames(chicken_mapped) <- gene_map$mouse_gene


# 1. Define the cluster source (pick one)
# If you use Idents:
mouse_cluster_vec = mouse_data_sub$med_2p_branch#Idents(mouse_data)
# OR if you use a metadata column:
# mouse_cluster_vec <- mouse_data_sub$your_cluster_column

# 2. Align cluster labels to mouse_expr columns
mouse_clusters <- mouse_cluster_vec[ colnames(mouse_expr) ]
length(mouse_clusters)  # should now be 7184
# Assuming chicken_seurat is your chicken Seurat object
# and chicken_expr was derived from it:
chicken_cluster_vec <- chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub$cell_type  # or Idents(chicken_seurat)
chicken_clusters <- chicken_cluster_vec[ colnames(chicken_expr) ]
length(chicken_clusters)  # should be 1380

############################################
## 5. Align genes across species
############################################
shared_genes <- intersect(
  rownames(mouse_expr),
  rownames(chicken_mapped)
)

mouse_expr   <- mouse_expr[shared_genes, ]
chicken_expr <- chicken_mapped[shared_genes, ]

############################################
## 6. Combine expression matrices
############################################
expr_all <- cbind(mouse_expr, chicken_expr)

############################################
## 7. MetaNeighbor metadata
############################################
cell_metadata <- data.frame(
  cell_id = colnames(expr_all),
  species = c(
    rep("mouse", ncol(mouse_expr)),
    rep("chicken", ncol(chicken_expr))
  ),
  cluster = c(
    as.character(mouse_clusters),
    as.character(chicken_clusters)
  )
)


rownames(cell_metadata) <- cell_metadata$cell_id

############################################
## 8. Gene set (recommended: mouse HVGs)
############################################
geneset <- intersect(
  VariableFeatures(mouse_data_sub),
  rownames(expr_all)
)


geneset_idx <- which(rownames(expr_all) %in% geneset)

############################################
## 9. Wrap expression in SummarizedExperiment
############################################
# This avoids the MetaNeighbor dgCMatrix assay() bug
se <- SummarizedExperiment(
  assays = list(expr = expr_all)
)

############################################
## 10. Run MetaNeighbor (THIS WORKS)
############################################
############################################
## 8. Gene set FIX: use all shared genes
############################################
geneset_idx <- seq_len(nrow(expr_all))

mn <- MetaNeighborUS(
  var_genes = geneset,
  dat = se,
  study_id = cell_metadata$species,
  cell_type = cell_metadata$cluster,
  fast_version = TRUE
)

############################################
## 11. Mouse ↔ Chicken AUROC matrix
############################################
# Full AUROC matrix
auroc <- mn

# Identify mouse and chicken rows/cols by name
mouse_rows    <- grep("^mouse\\|", rownames(auroc), value = TRUE)
chicken_cols  <- grep("^chicken\\|", colnames(auroc), value = TRUE)

mouse_vs_chicken <- auroc[mouse_rows, chicken_cols]

############################################

############################################

windowsFonts(Arial = windowsFont("Arial"))  # Windows only
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(dplyr)

## 1. Load and clean ortholog table
# orthos <- read.csv("mouse_chicken_1to1_orthologs.csv")  # if not already in memory
orthos_df <- orthos_df %>%
  distinct(mouse_gene, chicken_gene)

# Keep only orthologs actually present in each object
mouse_present   <- intersect(orthos_df$mouse_gene,   rownames(mouse_data))
chicken_present <- intersect(orthos_df$chicken_gene, rownames(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub))

orthos_sub <- orthos_df %>%
  filter(mouse_gene %in% mouse_present,
         chicken_gene %in% chicken_present) %>%
  arrange(mouse_gene)

mouse_genes   <- orthos_sub$mouse_gene
chicken_genes <- orthos_sub$chicken_gene

## 2. Subset each Seurat object to ortholog genes
mouse_ortho <- subset(mouse_data,   features = mouse_genes)
chick_ortho <- subset(chicken_integrated_dcn_granule_sub, features = chicken_genes)
```


```{r}
DefaultAssay(chick_ortho) <- "RNA"
chick_ortho <- JoinLayers(chick_ortho)
counts <- GetAssayData(
  chick_ortho,
  assay = "RNA",
  layer = "counts"
)

## 2. Transform gene names: lowercase + capitalize first letter
new_names <- rownames(counts)
new_names <- tolower(new_names)
new_names <- paste0(
  toupper(substr(new_names, 1, 1)),
  substr(new_names, 2, nchar(new_names))
)

rownames(counts) <- new_names

## 3. Rebuild RNA assay cleanly
chick_ortho[["RNA"]] <- CreateAssayObject(counts = counts)
DefaultAssay(chick_ortho) <- "RNA"

## 4. Reprocess
chick_ortho <- NormalizeData(chick_ortho)
chick_ortho <- FindVariableFeatures(chick_ortho)
chick_ortho <- ScaleData(chick_ortho)
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(mouse_ortho_e1234_sub) <- "SCT"

mouse_ortho_e1234_sub$species <- "mouse"

combined <- list(mouse_ortho_e1234_sub, chick_ortho)

features_use <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = combined)

combined <- PrepSCTIntegration(combined, assay = "SCT", anchor.features = features_use)
combined <- lapply(X = combined, FUN = RunPCA, features = features_use)
```


```{r}


anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list     = combined,
  anchor.features = features_use,
  reduction = "cca",
  normalization.method = "SCT",
  dims = 1:50)

integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = anchors, normalization.method = "SCT", dims = 1:50)

## 5. Downstream dimensionality reduction and clustering
DefaultAssay(integrated) <- "integrated"
```

```{r}
library(Seurat)
library(SeuratObject)
library(SeuratDisk)
DefaultAssay(chicken_integrated_dcn_ref) <- "RNA"
chicken_data <- merge(chicken_integrated_dcn_ref, y = data_li_sub)
# Step 1. Split Seurat object by metadata feature
# Replace "collector" with your metadata column name
chicken_list <- SplitObject(chicken_data, split.by = "collector")

# Step 2. Normalize, find variable features, and run PCA for each dataset
chicken_list <- lapply(chicken_list, function(x) {
  x <- NormalizeData(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- FindVariableFeatures(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- ScaleData(x, assay = "RNA")
  x <- RunPCA(x, assay = "RNA")
  return(x)
})

# Step 3. Select integration features
features <- SelectIntegrationFeatures(object.list = chicken_list, nfeatures = 300)

# Step 4. Find integration anchors using RPCA
# The reduction = "rpca" argument triggers RPCA-based integration
chicken_anchors <- FindIntegrationAnchors(
  object.list = chicken_list,
  anchor.features = features,
  reduction = "rpca"
)

# Step 5. Integrate the datasets
chicken_integrated <- IntegrateData(anchorset = chicken_anchors)

# Step 6. Downstream analysis
DefaultAssay(chicken_integrated) <- "integrated"
chicken_integrated <- ScaleData(chicken_integrated)
chicken_integrated <- RunPCA(chicken_integrated)
chicken_integrated <- RunUMAP(chicken_integrated, dims = 1:30)

# Step 7. (Optional) Clustering
chicken_integrated <- FindNeighbors(chicken_integrated, dims = 1:30)
chicken_integrated <- FindClusters(chicken_integrated, resolution = 0.5)
```

```{r}
nExp <- round(0.008 * ncol(seurat_sub))
library(DoubletFinder)

# Run UMAP before DoubletFinder (helps cluster info)
seurat_sub <- RunUMAP(seurat_sub, dims = 1:10)
seurat_sub <- FindNeighbors(seurat_sub, dims = 1:10)
seurat_sub <- FindClusters(seurat_sub, resolution = 0.5)

# DoubletFinder requires running with optimized pK
sweep.res.list <- paramSweep_v3(seurat_sub, PCs = 1:10, sct = FALSE)
sweep.stats <- summarizeSweep(sweep.res.list, GT = FALSE)
bcmvn <- find.pK(sweep.stats)

# Choose the best pK (based on the maximum BCmetric)
best_pK <- bcmvn$pK[which.max(bcmvn$BCmetric)]

# Run DoubletFinder with optimal pK
seurat_obj <- doubletFinder_v3(seurat_sub, PCs = 1:10, pN = 0.25, pK = as.numeric(as.character(best_pK)), nExp = nExp, reuse.pANN = FALSE, sct = FALSE)

```
